notes: imd/acc Sepolia test run 4, the last before mainnet: one contract, the ProjectRegistry, the list of projects whose cashback earns points, decided by IdentityMD oracle panels through Intake v2 (0xa43e...de82, paid in the Sepolia test IMD 0x44a1...f89a). It is the code the mainnet registry will use, with Sepolia settings, and asks the panel with version 2 of the rules (docs/panel-rules-v2.md). It is wired to test run 2's live Stacker 0x0457...314d (launch #1294), which is not redeployed: that Stacker runs src/Stacker.sol byte for byte on the live TestIMD and TestSIMD, and PLEA's hook already credits through it; the registry only names it in its questions and never calls it. Anyone applies or challenges, paying the oracle fee read live from the Intake (0.5 test IMD), plus a 5 test-IMD bond for a challenge (cooldown 3600 s). Answers are accepted only from the Intake, for its own open request, signed by the oracle signer 0x5598...2982 for this contract, from a 15-seat panel with 11 agreeing. A listed project's beneficiary may hand its points to another wallet at most once per day (HANDOFF_INTERVAL; HandoffTooSoon otherwise) and never while a question is open, so it can't move the wallet ahead of every challenge. Settling or clearing a question never waits on paying a bond: if the token refuses the transfer, the bond is recorded in bondOwed and its recipient takes it later with claimBond(to). Questions are filed under chain 1 because the oracle has no Sepolia RPC. No owner; its constructor makes no external call. Test doubles under test/mocks are not deployed.
